entities.summary: Kumail Ali Nanjiani is a Pakistani and American stand-up comedian, actor, producer and screenwriter. His accolades include a Screen Actors Guild Award, in addition to nominations for an Academy Award, Golden Globe Award, and two Emmy Awards. In 2018, Time magazine named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world.
